{"people":[{"name":"Priya","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Daniel","role":"VP of Engineering; signed the deal","side":"customer"},{"name":"CFO (unnamed)","role":"finance; joined one call","side":"customer"},{"name":"Customer engineer (unnamed)","role":"engineer who built the weekend prototype","side":"customer"},{"name":"Braintree","role":"payments provider the customer spoke with mid-evaluation","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Braintree"],
"incumbent":null,
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"They were launching Canada, then the UK, and sitters have to get paid locally.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Expansion into Canada and UK created the local sitter-payment need."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"a haunted house.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (customer, VP of Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own description of the payments code."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Customer tied up two engineers on upkeep, a cost of the status quo."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"There was also a roadmap item, faster pay for sitters, that had been pushed three quarters in a row.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Faster sitter pay was a repeatedly delayed roadmap item."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"He signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep names Daniel as the signer."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CFO joined one call for ten minutes, asked one question","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"CFO's involvement was brief, one call."},
{"id":"E7","turn":4,"excerpt":"does this change when sitters get paid?","label":"quote","speaker":"CFO (customer, finance)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","message"],"note":"CFO's only question focused on sitter pay timing."},
{"id":"E8","turn":4,"excerpt":"this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (customer, VP of Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Daniel said finance would only sign what he brought them."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"I've stopped learning their names.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (customer, VP of Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Customer frustration with competitor's account-manager churn."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"Their account manager had changed three times in two years.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor account manager turnover, per rep."},
{"id":"E11","turn":6,"excerpt":"they were nervous about what happens to those buttons.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Rep's read of customer nervousness about PayPal and Venmo, not a quote."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"They had a call with Braintree in the middle of the evaluation.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Customer had a mid-evaluation call with Braintree."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"Do we lose PayPal, do we lose Venmo, what happens to the saved cards.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","trigger"],"note":"Rep's paraphrase of questions that shifted after the Braintree call."},
{"id":"E14","turn":8,"excerpt":"how fast can we build this","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (questions, per rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Early customer question: speed of building in-house."},
{"id":"E15","turn":8,"excerpt":"what do we lose","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (questions, per rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Later customer question shifted to loss risk."},
{"id":"E16","turn":8,"excerpt":"I assume Braintree told them they'd lose things.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's assumption about what Braintree said."},
{"id":"E17","turn":8,"excerpt":"That's me guessing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep admits the Braintree claim is a guess."},
{"id":"E18","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the docs and the sandbox.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Docs and sandbox drew a positive reaction."},
{"id":"E19","turn":10,"excerpt":"One of their engineers, on her own time, built a working sitter payment flow over a weekend and showed it at Monday standup.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Weekend prototype appears to be the turning point."},
{"id":"E20","turn":10,"excerpt":"Onboarding sitters, the identity checks, paying out in local currency.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Marketplace pitch points as presented by rep."},
{"id":"E21","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the acceptance-rate slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Acceptance-rate pitch drew silence."},
{"id":"E22","turn":10,"excerpt":"I did the whole thing, the average improvement customers see.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep presented generic average improvement data."},
{"id":"E23","turn":10,"excerpt":"our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (customer, VP of Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer dismissed auth-rate messaging; 'our' is Daniel's company."},
{"id":"E24","turn":12,"excerpt":"The weekend prototype.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's read of the moment they felt it was won."},
{"id":"E25","turn":12,"excerpt":"After that Daniel stopped saying \"if.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep observed Daniel's change in hedging language after prototype."},
{"id":"E26","turn":14,"excerpt":"Nothing, really.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's answer on unmet asks; contradicted by later gaps."},
{"id":"E27","turn":14,"excerpt":"It was a clean one.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's own characterization of the deal."},
{"id":"E28","turn":16,"excerpt":"We said they could keep offering PayPal and we'd work through the details in implementation.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"PayPal answer deferred to implementation."},
{"id":"E29","turn":16,"excerpt":"I didn't have a crisp answer on Venmo in the room, and I still don't.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Venmo question was never answered clearly."},
{"id":"E30","turn":16,"excerpt":"They decided it was a risk they'd take.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's read: customer accepted PayPal/Venmo risk."},
{"id":"E31","turn":18,"excerpt":"We walked them through moving saved cards over so nobody has to re-enter anything.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Saved-card answer was a doc and conversation."},
{"id":"E32","turn":18,"excerpt":"who's done this at our size without losing cards?","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (customer, VP of Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Daniel asked for a comparable customer; rep never answered."},
{"id":"E33","turn":18,"excerpt":"I said I'd get back to him. I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep failed to follow up on the reference question."},
{"id":"E34","turn":20,"excerpt":"we'll find out.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer engineer (unnamed)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer engineer's response on card-loss risk; unresolved."},
{"id":"E35","turn":20,"excerpt":"Once, in the kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Daniel raised the saved-card concern again only once."},
{"id":"E36","turn":22,"excerpt":"Payments shouldn't be a team,","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (customer, VP of Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's framing of payments as a non-team problem."},
{"id":"E37","turn":22,"excerpt":"We want to stop babysitting this.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (customer, VP of Engineering, implied)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's stated goal, in their own words."},
{"id":"E38","turn":22,"excerpt":"paid by Friday.","label":"quote","speaker":"sitters (customer-side promise)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Sitter-facing promise the customer organizes around."},
{"id":"E39","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody there says \"marketplace.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Rep observed the customer avoids our term 'marketplace'."},
{"id":"E40","turn":22,"excerpt":"the app.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (unnamed)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's term for the product, in place of 'marketplace'."},
{"id":"E41","turn":22,"excerpt":"sitter pay.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (unnamed)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's term for payouts."},
{"id":"E42","turn":24,"excerpt":"I barely sold this.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's self-assessment of their selling role."},
{"id":"E43","turn":24,"excerpt":"Their engineer did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep credits the customer engineer with closing."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E5","E8"],"what":"Rep says Daniel signed, but Daniel said finance would sign whatever he brought them."},
{"evidence":["E26","E28"],"what":"Rep says 'Nothing, really' was asked for, yet PayPal was deferred to implementation."},
{"evidence":["E27","E29"],"what":"Rep calls it a clean deal, but admits no crisp answer on Venmo in the room."},
{"evidence":["E31","E33","E34"],"what":"Rep says saved cards were 'handled,' but admits never following up on the reference and the customer engineer said 'we'll find out.'"}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What changed in their questions after they'd met with them?","turn":7,"what":"Answered with a guess about Braintree's messaging, then said 'That's me guessing.'"},
{"question":"What did they ask for that we couldn't show?","turn":13,"what":"Answered 'Nothing, really. It was a clean one,' contradicted by unresolved PayPal, Venmo and saved-card questions."},
{"question":"What did we show them on that?","turn":15,"what":"Answered 'We kind of danced around it,' with no specific answer given."},
{"question":"And the saved cards?","turn":17,"what":"Said 'That one we handled' but admitted an unanswered reference request."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"sitter pay","ours":"payouts","evidence":["E41","E20"]},
{"theirs":"the app","ours":"marketplace","evidence":["E39","E40"]},
{"theirs":"auth rates","ours":"acceptance-rate","evidence":["E23","E21"]},
{"theirs":"paid by Friday","ours":"paying out in local currency","evidence":["E38","E20"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E24","E25","E27"],"what":"Rep says the deal was won after the weekend prototype; Daniel stopped hedging with 'if' and the rep called it a clean one."},
{"evidence":["E5","E30"],"what":"Daniel signed, and the customer accepted the PayPal and Venmo risk; the transcript does not say whether all of the business moved."},
{"evidence":["E1"],"what":"Expansion to Canada and then the UK drove the evaluation; the transcript does not say whether that scope was fully signed."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says Daniel signed, but Daniel said finance would sign whatever he brought them.
Rep says 'Nothing, really' was asked for, yet PayPal was deferred to implementation.
Rep calls it a clean deal, but admits no crisp answer on Venmo in the room.
Rep says saved cards were 'handled,' but admits never following up on the reference and the customer engineer said 'we'll find out.'

dodges.question: What changed in their questions after they'd met with them?
dodges.what: Answered with a guess about Braintree's messaging, then said 'That's me guessing.'

dodges.question: What did they ask for that we couldn't show?
dodges.what: Answered 'Nothing, really. It was a clean one,' contradicted by unresolved PayPal, Venmo and saved-card questions.

dodges.question: What did we show them on that?
dodges.what: Answered 'We kind of danced around it,' with no specific answer given.

dodges.question: And the saved cards?
dodges.what: Said 'That one we handled' but admitted an unanswered reference request.

outcome_signals.what: Rep says the deal was won after the weekend prototype; Daniel stopped hedging with 'if' and the rep called it a clean one.
Daniel signed, and the customer accepted the PayPal and Venmo risk; the transcript does not say whether all of the business moved.
Expansion to Canada and then the UK drove the evaluation; the transcript does not say whether that scope was fully signed.
